subject: Shed Vessel Ligands Anchor in Muscle Matrix to Drive Age-Related Decay
script: From Agewell Brief: Shed Vessel Ligands Anchor in Muscle Matrix to Drive Age-Related Decay. A protein released by aging blood vessels anchors in collagen matrix, hyperactivating Notch2 receptors to trigger vascular breakdown and muscle wasting. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
